SELECT
    id,
    title,
    initial_idea,
    description,
    status,
    created_at
FROM projects
WHERE id = $1::uuid;

WITH inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO clarification_questions
        (project_id, question, category, priority, status)
    SELECT
        $1::uuid,
        q.question,
        q.category,
        q.priority,
        'pending'
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb)
        AS q(question TEXT, category TEXT, priority TEXT)
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM clarification_questions existing
        WHERE existing.project_id = $1::uuid
          AND existing.question = q.question
    )
    RETURNING id, project_id, question, category,
              priority, status, created_at
)
SELECT * FROM inserted;

SELECT COUNT(*)::integer AS question_count
FROM clarification_questions
WHERE project_id = $1::uuid
  AND status = 'pending';

SELECT
    id,
    project_id,
    question,
    category,
    priority,
    status,
    created_at
FROM clarification_questions
WHERE project_id = $1::uuid
  AND status = 'pending'
ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC;
